name: scratch-to-reveal
title: Scratch To Reveal
blurb: Scratch the surface to reveal hidden content below.
description: Canvas-based overlay where users scratch away a gradient layer to reveal children. Detects when scratched area exceeds threshold; triggers callback and animates completion.
use_when: An interactive reveal for hidden information, promotions, or gamified interactions that reward engagement.
avoid_when: When content must be immediately accessible or when you cannot fix width/height dimensions upfront.
a11y: Scratch interaction requires pointer (mouse or touch); keyboard users cannot access. No fallback text or alternative method.
